summary: FEL OS full backend + frontend validation. 26/26 pytest tests passed on /api/education/* and /api/system-scan/*. Frontend verified end-to-end with two seeded sessions: (1) fresh happy-path user ran full Kinesiology certificate flow including quiz, XP award, eligibility panel, Brain Brawl deep-link button; (2) low-PRQ user confirmed claim button is rendered but disabled, eligibility panel shows PRQ gate unmet, bio-digital quick-complete and final-assessment opener render as expected. All 4 quadrants + 4 tracks + lesson runner + final assessment runner functional. Auth gating, idempotency, and refactor regression all green.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/system_scan.py line 56 calls `await db.list_collection_names()` inside a conditional — fine but adds an extra roundtrip per scan; consider caching or simply counting unconditionally (empty count returns 0).

education_tracks.py strip_correct only returns {q, options}; good. But lesson detail endpoint (/api/education/tracks/{track_id}/lesson/{lesson_id}) should arguably require auth (currently public) — acceptable since answers are stripped, but worth flagging.
No rate limit on /api/education/brain-brawl/launch — user could spam to bloat brain_brawl_launches collection. Consider a cooldown/TTL index.
Certificate idempotency relies on a single doc per (user_id, track_id); recommend adding a unique compound index to prevent any race-condition double issuance under load.
